$comment: One canonical reader category set for AI Resource Hub news, the daily edition and the email picker. Agreed 12 Nov 2026 (hub #1495, #1497, #1498). Every legacy vocabulary maps here. Benchmark, pricing_change and open_source stay as tags, not categories. Used by src/data/news-categories.ts, scripts/backfill-news-categories.mjs and the newsletter Worker. Keep ids stable: subscriber preferences store them.

categories.label: Models
categories.description: New and updated AI models: launches, versions, open weights and model cards.

categories.label: Tools
categories.description: Products, apps, APIs and developer tools built on AI.

categories.label: Agents
categories.description: AI agents, computer use, tool calling and the protocols that connect them.

categories.label: Research
categories.description: Papers, studies, datasets and findings from labs and universities.

categories.label: Industry
categories.description: Companies, funding, deals, chips, data centres and the people running them.

categories.label: Policy
categories.description: Law, regulation, courts, safety and government action on AI.

categories.label: Voices
categories.description: Interviews, podcasts, talks and opinion from people in AI.

legacyMap.$comment: Source vocabulary value -> canonical id. null means not AI news for this site (excluded from editions).

keywordRules.$comment: Matched against title + summary (case-insensitive). Order: policy, voices, agents, research keywords first; then the source label unless it is the catch-all industry; then industry, models, tools keywords; then the source label, else industry. See classifyNewsItem in src/data/news-categories.ts.

patterns.policy: \b(regulat\w*|legislat\w*|lawsuit|sued|sues|court|judge|copyright|antitrust|senate|congress|parliament|ministry|government|white house|executive order|eu ai act|ai act|export control\w*|ban(s|ned)?|ai policy|public policy|policymakers?|policy makers?|regulators?|safety institute|watchdog|ftc|ofcom)\b
patterns.voices: \b(interview(ed)? (with|by)|in an interview|podcast|in conversation|fireside chat|q&a|op-ed|opinion:|keynote|sits down with)\b
